definition: Nothing in the corpus is called what you typed. The search reads names, ids and other names only, never the prose of a tell or a remedy; for a remembered phrase, ask the assistant, which reads the records themselves.
basis: Our wording of what an empty search means. docs/workbench.md gives the boundary the search keeps and why: "indexing every fault's remedy and every style's" "diagnostic tells quadrupled the payload and produced matches nobody could account for".
